name: Big Bass Vegas Double Down Deluxe

features.name: Dynamite feature
features.description: A collector landing with no cash on screen replaces the bottom reels with cash.

features.name: Bazooka
features.description: Turns symbols into cash when the fisherman lands without fish.

features.name: Retriggers
features.description: Every fourth fisherman awards 10 more spins and a higher multiplier.

review:
The fisherman hits the Las Vegas strip, with neon signs filling the 5x3 reels. Three scatters give up to 20 free spins, and two can trigger a random feature to try for a third.

Two nice rescues in the bonus: if a collector lands with no cash on screen, dynamite fills the bottom reels with cash; if the fisherman lands with no fish, the bazooka turns symbols into cash. That means fewer empty bonus spins. 96.5% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
